addIntro: Detect machines on the local network or choose a type to enter it manually.
scanningHelp: The scan takes up to a minute: FabCore queries every address of the network.
noNetwork: No local network available on the FabCore server.
nothingFound: No machine identified. Manual entry is still available.
manualHelp: Choose the machine type, then enter its address and credentials.
detectedAt: Machine detected at {host}. Complete the details, then test the connection.
name: Machine name
ray5Note: Experimental TCP control; ESP3D: monitoring and SD card. Wi-Fi and firmware settings are unchanged.
m2Note: xTool M2: click “Pair”, then confirm on the machine screen (45 s).
pairing: Confirm pairing on the M2 when prompted. FabCore waits up to 45 seconds.
cloudSettings: This machine belongs to a Bambu Lab cloud account: manage it from the cloud accounts.
rediscoverHelp: Finds this machine on the network if its address changed.
stillThere: The machine still answers at {host}. No address change needed.
chooseAddress: Choose the new address, then click Save.
nothingElse: No other machine of this type found on {network}. Check that it is on and connected to Wi-Fi.
addressFilled: Address {host} filled in. Click Save to confirm it.
deleteHelp: Removes the machine from FabCore and closes its connections. Nothing changes on the machine.

errors.machine-invalid: Check the machine name, private IPv4 address and credentials.
errors.cloud-machine-exists: This printer is already tracked by a cloud account.
errors.probe-busy: A test is already running. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.xtool-pairing-busy: A pairing with this M2 is already running.
errors.machine-changed: The record changed during the test. Reopen it and try again.
errors.command-busy: A command is running on this machine.
errors.rate: Too many requests. Wait a moment.
errors.connection: The machine does not answer. Check its address and network.
